name.value: The Joined Sheet at the Fourth Ground

description.value: At flood the scattered bodies on this stretch of flat gather in the shallows and join edge to edge into a single sheet, which decides everything that needs deciding and remembers what the separate bodies did while apart. It is not an assembly of individuals: a body alone has no name, will not answer, and is treated by the sheet the way a hand is treated by a person. The discipline records it as one body because, asked directly at the fourth meeting whether it was one thing or many, it said one.

role.value: flood-phase authority over the stake lines

notes.value: The active dates record when the register first met it. It exists for about four hours at a time, which the field for active years has no way of saying.
